# Components

The catalogue of `@tuja/ui`. Each line names a component, where it imports from and when to reach for it, in the order a screen is built. Each group ends with its detail file: every prop and an example.

- Import each component from its own path, `import { ListRow } from "@tuja/ui/components/list-row";`. A path in braces, `components/{card,card-header}`, is one path per name.
- Every component takes `css`, StyleX styles composed last, and none takes `className` or `style`.
- Icons are Phosphor: `import { PlusIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react/dist/ssr/Plus";`, passed as `icon={<PlusIcon weight="bold" />}`. A `TabView` item takes the component itself, `icon: PlusIcon`.
- The apps translate every string a visitor reads, `t({ en: "Save", zh: "保存" })` (the `i18n-patterns` skill); the examples use plain strings.
- In a Next app, the `linkComponent` and `linkStatus` of `TabView` and `NavigationSplitView` take `Link` and `LinkStatus` from `@tuja/next-links/link`.

## App frame and page layout

- `TabView`, `TabViewBrand` from `@tuja/ui/components/{tab-view,tab-view-brand}`: The frame of an app with top-level destinations: a rail or sidebar from `md`, a tab bar below it. Wrap every screen in one.
- `NavigationSplitView` from `@tuja/ui/components/navigation-split-view`: The columns of one screen inside a `TabView`: an optional sidebar (a list of accounts, settings sections), the content, and an optional detail. Use it with `content` alone for a one-pane screen.
- `HeaderFooterLayout` from `@tuja/ui/components/header-footer-layout`: The shell of a reading page with no app frame: floating header controls at the top, the content, a footer.
- `StickyControls`, `StickyControlGroup` from `@tuja/ui/components/{sticky-controls,sticky-control-group}`: A filter bar that sticks under the header while the page scrolls; one group per cluster of controls.
- `pageColumn.{base,scroller,wide,regular,list,settings,report}` from `@tuja/ui/primitives/page-column.stylex`: The page column's width. Give `pageColumn.list`, `settings` or `report` to the `css` of a `TabView` or `NavigationSplitView`; compose `base` on a box of your own.
- `show.{fromMd,belowMd}` from `@tuja/ui/primitives/show.stylex`: Show a box only on a wide `TabView` (`show.fromMd`) or only on a phone (`show.belowMd`), such as a `Table` that is a `List` on a phone. Put it on a wrapper.
- `stack.{text,rows,tight,item,group,section}` from `@tuja/ui/primitives/stack.stylex`: A column that owns the gap between its children: `section` between page blocks, `group` between cards, `item` inside a card, `tight` for a heading over its text.
- `cluster.{inline,tight,item}` from `@tuja/ui/primitives/stack.stylex`: A row that wraps, such as a line of badges or buttons.
- `row.{inline,tight,item}` from `@tuja/ui/primitives/stack.stylex`: A row that does not wrap, such as an icon beside its label or the buttons of a header.
- `flex.{row,col,center,between,wrap,inlineCenter}` from `@tuja/ui/primitives/flex.stylex`: A bare flex box with no gap; change one property after it with `align`, `justify`, `grow` or `shrink` from the same file.

Props and examples: [components/frame.md](components/frame.md)

## Page blocks

- `PageHeader` from `@tuja/ui/components/page-header`: The top of every page: eyebrow, the `<h1>`, a description and the page's own actions.
- `StatGroup`, `Stat` from `@tuja/ui/components/{stat-group,stat}`: Key figures in a row, such as spent, income and net, each on a card or plain inside one.
- `SettingList`, `SettingRow` from `@tuja/ui/components/{setting-list,setting-row}`: A settings page: one row per setting, its name and description at the start and one control at the end.
- `FormFooter` from `@tuja/ui/components/form-footer`: The Cancel and Save buttons at the end of a form, optionally sticky.
- `EmptyState` from `@tuja/ui/components/empty-state`: What a list, card or page shows when it has nothing yet, with the action that fills it.
- `Columns` from `@tuja/ui/components/columns`: Two or three columns side by side, such as a main column and an aside, that stack on a narrow box.

Props and examples: [components/blocks.md](components/blocks.md)

## Surfaces

- `Card`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter` from `@tuja/ui/components/{card,card-header,card-title,card-description,card-content,card-footer}`: A bordered surface that groups one topic. `Card` is already a `stack.item`, so put content straight in it.
- `Section` from `@tuja/ui/components/section`: A labelled block with a heading row and optional actions, with no surface of its own: a quiet label by default, a real heading with `look="heading"`, such as the day of a timeline.
- `Disclosure` from `@tuja/ui/components/disclosure`: A row that opens a panel under it, such as advanced options or an FAQ.
- `Divider` from `@tuja/ui/components/divider`: A line between two blocks that are not in a list.
- `ScrollMask` from `@tuja/ui/components/scroll-mask`: A scroll region whose content blurs out at each edge it can still scroll to.
- `FlowBlock` from `@tuja/ui/components/flow-block`: Wrap content that sits under a `Disclosure` and is not already a block, so it moves when the panel opens.

Props and examples: [components/surfaces.md](components/surfaces.md)

## Lists and tables

- `List`, `ListRow` from `@tuja/ui/components/{list,list-row}`: Rows that each open something, such as transactions or accounts: a name, a detail line, a value and a caret.
- `Table`, `TableHead`, `TableBody`, `TableFoot`, `TableRow`, `TableHeaderCell`, `TableCell` from `@tuja/ui/components/{table,table-head,table-body,table-foot,table-row,table-header-cell,table-cell}`: A static data table with columns to compare; not a data grid.
- `TableDisclosure`, `TableDisclosureTrigger` from `@tuja/ui/components/{table-disclosure,table-disclosure-trigger}`: A table row that opens a panel under it; use it in place of `TableBody`, one per row.
- `MetaLine` from `@tuja/ui/components/meta-line`: Facts on one line with a "·" between them, such as the detail line of a row.
- `Badge` from `@tuja/ui/components/badge`: A short status or label, such as Pending or Overdue.
- `StatusDot` from `@tuja/ui/components/status-dot`: A small dot that says something waits, beside a label or on an icon.
- `Avatar` from `@tuja/ui/components/avatar`: A person or organisation: portrait, logo or monogram.

Props and examples: [components/lists.md](components/lists.md)

## Text

- `Text` from `@tuja/ui/components/text`: All body copy, labels and captions; choose the size with `look` and the colour with `tone`.
- `Heading` from `@tuja/ui/components/heading`: A heading: `level` sets the rank, `look` the size.
- `CodeBlock` from `@tuja/ui/components/code-block`: A block of code drawn as coloured runs.

Props and examples: [components/text.md](components/text.md)

## Forms

- `TextField` from `@tuja/ui/components/text-field`: A one-line text input with its label, help and error.
- `Textarea` from `@tuja/ui/components/textarea`: A multi-line text input, optionally growing with its content.
- `Select` from `@tuja/ui/components/select`: One choice from a list of five or more, as a native `<select>`.
- `Switch` from `@tuja/ui/components/switch`: A setting that is on or off and applies at once.
- `Checkbox` from `@tuja/ui/components/checkbox`: A yes or no in a form that is saved later, or one pick of many.
- `SegmentedControl` from `@tuja/ui/components/segmented-control`: One of two to four views or kinds, such as Expense and Income.
- `FilterChips` from `@tuja/ui/components/filter-chips`: One filter of a list among any number that all show, such as All, Filed, Archived, Junk, with an optional count each; a row too wide scrolls sideways.
- `RadioGroup` from `@tuja/ui/components/radio-group`: One of a few plain answers, each a radio with a label and an optional description, such as when to notify.
- `OptionCardGroup`, `OptionCard`, `OptionCardStack` from `@tuja/ui/components/{option-card-group,option-card,option-card-stack}`: A choice where each answer needs a description, such as a plan; render `OptionCard`s yourself in an `OptionCardStack` for custom content.
- `Slider` from `@tuja/ui/components/slider`: A number in a range, picked by dragging.

Props and examples: [components/forms.md](components/forms.md)

## Actions and navigation

- `Button` from `@tuja/ui/components/button`: Every action and every link that looks like a button; `href` makes it a link.
- `MenuButton`, `MenuItem`, `MenuLabel` from `@tuja/ui/components/{menu-button,menu-item,menu-label}`: A button that opens a menu of commands, such as More with Rename and Delete.
- `NavList`, `NavGroup`, `NavLink` from `@tuja/ui/components/{nav-list,nav-group,nav-link}`: The links between the pages of one place, such as settings sections in a sidebar or the `secondary` of a `TabView`.
- `Anchor` from `@tuja/ui/components/anchor`: A text link inside a sentence, or standing alone.
- `Breadcrumb` from `@tuja/ui/components/breadcrumb`: The trail of pages above the current one.
- `Pager` from `@tuja/ui/components/pager`: Links to the previous and next page at the end of a page in a sequence.
- `ExternalLinkIndicator` from `@tuja/ui/components/external-link-indicator`: The icon and screen-reader text for a custom link that opens in a new tab.

Props and examples: [components/actions.md](components/actions.md)

## Feedback

- `Callout` from `@tuja/ui/components/callout`: A message in the page, such as a warning before a destructive step or the result of a check.
- `ToastProvider`, `Toast` from `@tuja/ui/components/{toast-provider,toast}`: A short message about what an action did, with Undo; call `useToast()` and wrap the app in `ToastProvider` once.
- `Progress` from `@tuja/ui/components/progress`: How much of a task of known length is done.
- `Spinner` from `@tuja/ui/components/spinner`: Work with no known end.
- `Skeleton` from `@tuja/ui/components/skeleton`: A placeholder in the shape of content that is loading.

Props and examples: [components/feedback.md](components/feedback.md)

## Overlays

- `Sheet` from `@tuja/ui/components/sheet`: A modal for a short task, such as a form to add or edit one thing; a bottom sheet on a phone.
- `Popover` from `@tuja/ui/components/popover`: Non-modal content hung off a trigger, such as details or a small form; for commands use `MenuButton`.

Props and examples: [components/overlays.md](components/overlays.md)

## App setup and effects

- `LinkProvider` from `@tuja/ui/components/link-provider`: Once at the root, so every `Button` with an `href` uses the router's link (`RouterLink` from `@tuja/next-links/router-link` in a Next app).
- `EffectLayerProvider` from `@tuja/ui/components/effect-layer-provider`: Once at the root of an app that draws WebGPU effects, such as the liquid of a `Switch`.
- `PortalTargetProvider` from `@tuja/ui/components/portal-target-provider`: Once at the root: the box that overlays such as `Sheet` and `Popover` portal into.
- `BlurPlaneProvider` from `@tuja/ui/components/blur-plane-provider`: Around a shell whose floating controls blur the page under them.
- `ProgressiveBlur` from `@tuja/ui/components/progressive-blur`: The page blurred around a floating element, in place of dimming it.
- `FixedContainerContent` from `@tuja/ui/components/fixed-container-content`: Around fixed content that flashes in Chrome during a view transition.
- `EffectCarrier`, `EffectContainer` from `@tuja/ui/components/{effect-carrier,effect-container}`: Say what the effects inside move with, or keep them inside one container.
- `useRipple`, `useLiquid`, `useDust`, `useExtractorFan`, `useLightBeam`, `useBlackHole` from `@tuja/ui/hooks/{use-ripple,use-liquid,use-dust,use-extractor-fan,use-light-beam,use-black-hole}`: Effect-layer hooks: attach the returned ref to an element. Read the `effect-layer` skill first.

Props and examples: [components/setup.md](components/setup.md)
